notes.title: Extended Demo now Live!
notes.content:
It's here! The extended demo for Snow White Ashes is now playable!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913634/37c9bbdf0f0c35437bb1a0fc24577480bf4f72ed.png[/img]

Delve back into the woods with this hefty update that includes an extra 15k words, tons of new artwork, new revelations and new mysteries...

Note: Old save files should still work, but I'd recommend starting a new one just to be safe (and to see the updated CGs!)

[i]Some earlier text has also been updated to offer more hints to the Hunter (and the MC's) true identities. [/i]

Please note that this update begins to delve into some of the darker parts of the story. A content warning will appear on screen when starting the game. A more detailed list can be [url=https://endysis.net/snow-white-ashes-content-warnings]found on my website. [/url]

[b]Demo v 1.0.5
New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Additional 15k words of story (21k total, about 1-2 hours playtime)
[*] [b]3 short, unlockable bonus scenes[/b]
[*] Updated gallery & music box
[*] Updated CGs and background art
[*] New CGs and illustrations
[*] New music tracks
[*] Additional sprites
[/list]

Known Issues:
[list]
[*] Certain MC dialogue not counting as "already seen text" when using the skip feature in one of the final scenes.
[/list]
